artifacts.notes: Complete offered Latin page, 81 physical lines; prologue and commentary through Susanna. The extractor’s repeated {1.0} prefixes are generated paragraph furniture, not valid native book/chapter loci: this delivery uses parenthesized CAP divisions the extractor does not recognize. Native biblical verse labels within paragraphs remain. Bare numeric page/column markers remain. No passage rises above inspected without facsimile collation.
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying Jerome Latin and Migne 1845 printing are in the United States public domain by publication date. The existing Migne extractor removes contributor templates, host navigation and the 2013 encoding note. No modern translation is included; pre-existing source wording remains public domain.
